After this, uses a Rail Gun to attack in the same direction, dealing <color=#F74848>0.7x</color> AoE DMG. Inflicts <color=#F74848>2</color> random debuffs on targets hit, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

400709.name: Thermal Streaming
